system.description: On learning this power, make an Extended Static Willpower Test against eight Traits; each success discards one derangement or two animal-behavior flaws (lost Social Traits from those flaws remain lost). Grants a permanent three-Trait bonus resisting mind-altering Disciplines/magic (not Presence or other emotion-affecting powers). If a new derangement is later imposed, a Static Willpower Test against seven Traits (spending three Mental Traits on success, no Willpower spend for retests) lets it fade after one night and the following day instead of persisting.
